meta.name: One Pace – Little Garden
meta.description:
The Straw Hats vow to bring Princess Vivi to Alabasta, and their journey brings them to Little Garden, an island from prehistoria that is home to creatures and people larger than life.

Arc 12 din One Pace: 5 episoade, capitole 115–129. Acoperă episoadele One Piece 70–79. Subtitrare în română.

videos.title: 01. Adventure on Little Garden
videos.overview: The Straw Hats arrive at their destination and discover that the island is home to enormous creatures... and people. Meanwhile, the Baroque Works agents Mr. 3 and his partner Miss Golden Week receive new orders.

videos.title: 02. Dorry and Brogy
videos.overview: Usopp, immensely impressed with the giants of Elbaph, names Brogy his master. To commemorate their duel, the giants imbibe two barrels of booze from Nami, but, unbeknownst to anyone, a saboteur has tampered with one of them!

videos.title: 03. Foul Play
videos.overview: Despite his internal injuries and Luffy's warnings, the prideful giant Dorry insists on continuing his duel with Brogy. Meanwhile, the Baroque Works officer agents begin to make their move on the island with the Straw Hats as their next targets.

videos.title: 04. Luffy vs. Mr. 3
videos.overview: Luffy, Usopp, and Karoo launch headlong into rescuing their friends, but Miss Golden Week runs a colorful interference. Mr. 3 is forced to take matters into his own conniving hands, and Usopp brainstorms how he will finally free his friends.

videos.title: 05. Straight Ahead!!
videos.overview: Sanji, pretending to be Mr. 3, convinces Crocodile he has eliminated Vivi and co., prompting the Unluckies to arrive and deliver a way off Little Garden. With a clear path straight ahead—or so it seems—the Straw Hats set sail.
